references.text: A similar response where many in Jerusalem believed in Jesus after a miracle, parallel to the faith in Perea in John 10:42.
Describes how many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus, a direct parallel to "πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν" in John 10:42.
Mentions that many of the leaders believed in Jesus but did not confess it, reflecting the presence of faith in John 10:42.
Describes how many believed in his name when they saw the signs he performed, a direct parallel to faith based on testimony in John 10:42.
Many Samaritans believed in him because of the woman's testimony, a parallel to the faith that arises in a specific place in John 10:42.
